ref.note: Mixed residual line. By the composition in data/2026/entities/social-security.json, almost all of it is spending of the employees' global management run by RSZ/ONSS (other external transfers, misc. spending, interest, capital spending) and the RIZIV/INAMI healthcare 'Diversen' row; neither document itemises the recipients, so the phrases stay general and name the two bodies. Small named items are left out so they do not dominate the impression: the self-employed bridging right and carer's allowance (Tabel III.3, p. 167, together well under 1% of the line), miners' and seamen's benefits, and interest. corrected: dropped the bridging-right and carer's-allowance phrases (under 1% of the line) and the vague 'various other costs' phrase; replaced by two general phrases naming where the bulk sits (RSZ/ONSS employees' global management and RIZIV/INAMI 'Diversen'); quote and locator updated to those rows; two phrases each way because the bulk is not itemised
